name: Apaj (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Apaj: a crowned green and blue shield, supported by two white horses, above a yellow scroll inscribed APAJ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Apaj arms with crown, horse supporters and scroll
